title: What I've built.
sub: A selection of products and experiments that explore different kinds of software, from astronomical simulation to AI systems, gaming infrastructure, and real-world marketplaces.

projects.title: Astrarium
projects.tagline: A real-time, to-scale solar system orrery and orbital simulation.
projects.description: Astrarium is an interactive, to-scale 3D orrery inspired by NASA's "Eyes on the Solar System", built around real astronomical data covering all planets, dwarf planets, and major moons. It features a Keplerian orbital simulation with true-to-scale orbital velocities, a custom time system spanning real-time motion to several years per second, and live orbit tracking, motion trails, and labels. To handle rendering at astronomical scales, I developed a custom high-precision line-rendering system using camera-relative coordinates, which I also published as an npm package. Guess where this website's starfield came from.

projects.title: BorrowBe
projects.tagline: A two-sided rental marketplace for discovering, listing, and renting things locally.
projects.description: BorrowBe is a two-sided rental marketplace connecting people through location-aware discovery, customizable listings, and peer-to-peer transactions. Its inheritance-based CMS lets categories define and selectively override listing attributes, pricing packages, and limits. The platform also combines address and geospatial search, real-time messaging and notifications, and a Stripe-integrated wallet with recurring payments.

projects.title: Context Studio
projects.tagline: An AI knowledge and content workspace built around persistent context.
projects.description: Context Studio is an AI knowledge and content workspace that turns documents and notes into a searchable, persistent knowledge base. Its ingestion pipeline processes documents in the background, while a hybrid retrieval system combines lexical and vector search based on query characteristics. A feedback-driven research brief system carries user preferences into subsequent generations, adapting topic and source weighting over time.

projects.title: PoundAK
projects.tagline: A gaming companion platform for realtime telemetry, overlays, and AI-assisted analysis.
projects.description: PoundAK is a desktop gaming companion built around live game telemetry and multiple coordinated application contexts. It combines in-game overlays, desktop interfaces, background services, and hotkey-driven windows into a unified runtime, using game events to power real-time assistance and performance analysis. Its experimental AI coaching system combines gameplay statistics, session history, and player preferences into contextual prompts for different language models.
